answer.action: Banks and operators must comply with the consolidated Domestic Money Transfer directions, operational safeguards, transaction limits, and customer grievance redressal mechanisms.
answer.action_quote: these Directions shall be applicable to all Scheduled Commercial Banks, including Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Urban Co -operative Banks, State Co- operative Banks, District Central Co -operative Banks, and Authorised Payment System Operators and System Participants

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall be effective immediately.
